analysis.name: task_phase_confound
analysis.reason_for_excluding_offpath_crashes: wall-visibility control should not also be a collision control
analysis.collision_window_definition: cond == wall, crashed_episode == true, 0 <= steps_to_crash <= T
analysis.loso_group_definition: five on-path scenario IDs; paired no-wall rows share the held-out ID; off-path controls remain available in each fold

loso_classification.pool: all wall rows + all no-wall rows + safe off-path rows; label is on-path collision within T

classifier.model: standardized L2 logistic regression, full-batch gradient descent
classifier.hidden_preprocessing: training-fold deterministic randomized PCA-50 (seed 0, 2 power iterations) before the same logistic regression

interpretation.wall_visibility_confound: The off-path-safe matched group has a wall in the capture but no collision. If its frozen probe logit stays near no-wall, wall visibility alone is insufficient; if it rises, the probe may be reading visibility.
interpretation.generic_task_phase_confound: Timestep-only and EEF/action covariate LOSO scores quantify how much collision-window membership can be predicted from progress, robot pose, and action magnitude without hidden state.
interpretation.collision_specific_information: Evidence for collision-specific hidden information requires a high hidden-state LOSO score that remains above the covariate baselines and a positive on-path-minus-control logit gap after both matching audits. This is associational, not causal.
interpretation.final_test: Compare hidden_state ROC-AUC/AUPRC with timestep + EEF xyz + action magnitude; the latter is the preregistered observable-confound baseline.
